bounded_interface_domain: The literal common object, actual source mechanism, receiving decision, configuration, time and responsibility boundary are identified.

The named mechanism supplies the precise evidence, competence, continuity, constraint or authority input stated in the separately reasoned direction. Co-location or an invented auxiliary system is insufficient.
Competence, access, independent challenge, delegation, regulatory credit and risk acceptance remain distinct; one does not establish the others.
The complete receiver criterion and applicable obligations remain separate from the material partial contribution. A genuine partial input need not establish the entire receiving predicate.
Unknown applicability or correspondence stays unknown; no common-object guard is inferred merely from matching vocabulary.
source_record.native_common_basis: Provide shared platform capabilities when they reduce total consumer and operator burden while preserving useful choice and feedback.
common_cost_and_alternative: Count knowledge transfer, retained evidence, review, coordination, platform operation, consumer migration, exception handling and delayed decisions over the actual lifecycle.
Retain adequate existing controls, concise records, specialist ownership with backup, finite projects with competent handover, direct services, libraries, templates and no change as alternatives.
Authority follows the actual regime. Same-person roles or preauthorized local decisions remain possible where permitted; an actual separation requirement remains binding where applicable.

Do not count repeated shared evidence or the same common platform capacity as independent corroboration or independent savings. Actual platform net benefit and organizational comparative effects remain conditional.
source_record.evidence_ceiling: Root literal analytical arguments from the complete selected native bodies and eight executed finite discriminators. One bounded NASA standard corroborates scoped distinctions, not universal authority requirements or causal effect sizes. No new property, field experiment, whole-synthesis completion or independent acceptance.

common_subconditions.P1: The literal common object and actual receiving use exist.
common_subconditions.P2: Both complete native meanings govern, including nontriggers and limits.
common_subconditions.P3: The separately reasoned partial contribution follows under its actual scope.
common_subconditions.P4: Residual premises, stronger-claim witnesses, alternatives and re-entry remain.

source_record.inference: The named input changes the specified receiving inquiry, capability or decision under its guard. It does not grant another role, certify a whole object, establish causal superiority or create a new implementation requirement.
source_record.common_source_dependence: One scoped NASA primary standard; multiple retrieved passages count once. Existing selected native sources retain their evidence ceilings.

Known absence of this particular common use defeats the guarded instance, not every other possible material use; an unestablished guard is not a global negative.

positive_controls.argument: Actual change scopes, authority routes and recurring consumer impacts define requirements and escape cases for the shared capability.
Real recipient criteria, evidence forms and item boundaries define which reusable services help consumers and where specific handling is required.
The applicable certification basis identifies reuse limits, required configurations and change effects that the platform must expose to its consumers.
The challenge arrangement's access, competence and independence constraints specify how platform permissions, reproducibility and reporting must work for that use.
The argument's platform-dependent claims and defeaters identify which evidence, interface guarantees and escape conditions the service must expose.
The actual obligations, risk differences and permissible alternatives delimit what can be shared and which consumers need an escape path or different control.
The model's semantics, federation, authority and reconciliation requirements define the platform functions and boundaries needed for meaningful consumer use.
The empowered actor's operating scope, current conditions and required stop behavior define the platform service limits and consumer-specific escalation path.

source.criterion: An appropriately empowered actor accepts or rejects the stated residual risk with current evidence and a defined operating boundary.

receiver.bearer: Repeated infrastructure needs across consumers with sufficiently common requirements.
receiver.criterion: Provide shared platform capabilities when they reduce total consumer and operator burden while preserving useful choice and feedback.

guard: The literal common object, actual source mechanism, receiving decision, configuration, time and responsibility boundary are identified.

The named mechanism supplies the precise evidence, competence, continuity, constraint or authority input stated in the separately reasoned direction. Co-location or an invented auxiliary system is insufficient.
Competence, access, independent challenge, delegation, regulatory credit and risk acceptance remain distinct; one does not establish the others.
The complete receiver criterion and applicable obligations remain separate from the material partial contribution. A genuine partial input need not establish the entire receiving predicate.
Unknown applicability or correspondence stays unknown; no common-object guard is inferred merely from matching vocabulary.
member_to_premise_evidence.source_contribution: The empowered actor's operating scope, current conditions and required stop behavior define the platform service limits and consumer-specific escalation path.
member_to_premise_evidence.receiving_consequence: The empowered actor's operating scope, current conditions and required stop behavior define the platform service limits and consumer-specific escalation path.
premises_supplied: The empowered actor's operating scope, current conditions and required stop behavior define the platform service limits and consumer-specific escalation path.
premises_remaining: Provide shared platform capabilities when they reduce total consumer and operator burden while preserving useful choice and feedback.
The receiver-native conditions not established by the literal partial contribution, including actual net benefit and any remaining authority or evidence.
member_to_premise_evidence.counterexample: One consumer's valid authorization does not authorize all platform tenants or prove the shared platform has positive net value.
member_to_premise_evidence.counter_control: One consumer's valid authorization does not authorize all platform tenants or prove the shared platform has positive net value.
member_to_premise_evidence.nontrigger: The stated common object or actual receiving use is known absent; if merely unknown, no negative is inferred.
specific_cost_and_alternative: Count knowledge transfer, retained evidence, review, coordination, platform operation, consumer migration, exception handling and delayed decisions over the actual lifecycle.
Retain adequate existing controls, concise records, specialist ownership with backup, finite projects with competent handover, direct services, libraries, templates and no change as alternatives.
Authority follows the actual regime. Same-person roles or preauthorized local decisions remain possible where permitted; an actual separation requirement remains binding where applicable.

Do not count repeated shared evidence or the same common platform capacity as independent corroboration or independent savings. Actual platform net benefit and organizational comparative effects remain conditional.
member_to_premise_evidence.reentry: Reopen affected directions on changed responsibilities, delegation, expiry, issuer/basis, configuration, model correspondence, critical knowledge, platform consumers or costs, current evidence, source correction or counterexample. Known absence of this particular common use defeats the guarded instance, not every other possible material use; an unestablished guard is not a global negative.
